# Code Anchors: Intake Lane

- `components/commands/nxs.intake.md` — the whole lane: the pull-request-only refusal, the empty-diff refusal, reading why from the pull request body, review threads and commit messages with per-decision source attribution, the one-prompt gather of unexplained decisions, the one approval gate, filing kept follow-ups as epic stubs, and the two-file entry it writes with its `pr_digest` stamp.
- `components/skills/nxs-landed-reference/SKILL.md` — the checkout-role gate, the three accepted reference forms, range resolution, and the qualification rule this lane shares with the fix lane.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/nxs-intake.spec.ts` — pins the command's derivations, refusals, attribution, gate, and the entry shape it writes.
- `components/commands/nxs.distill.md` — the drain side: the closed three-kind set, the pull-request-body fingerprint re-check replacing the record-hash branch, the full epic vocabulary with neither the fix razor's bounds nor the append-only validator mode applied, and the checkpoint's per-page-created/assertion-changed/invariant-retired block.
